title: Stan Lee's United Martial Arts

services.name: Kids Martial Arts
services.desc: We looked into many schools... We also attended a Tae Kwon Do program for 2 years... And by far this school is the best that we have the pleasure of attending... Stan Lee's program is very structured... The boys have to work hard to advance... My kids look forward to class... Very clean and organized... I highly recommend this school... Stan Lee's United Martial Arts teaches more than martial arts (although I very much like the real life aspect of the techniques). They expect the students to be good people, too.
